verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation SDK. The pack documents no in-product feature that analyzes a user's own data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions. extract() and observe() are developer primitives that pull structured data or candidate actions from webpages, not insights on the user's data, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
